# OpenClaw Source Holdout

This directory contains unmodified source and test snapshots from the public
`openclaw/openclaw` repository. The holdout was selected after the predicate,
guard, and decision corpus were frozen. The guard source was unchanged for this
evaluation.

OpenClaw issue
[`18583`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/18583) reported that the
OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` route discarded `image_url` parts.
Upstream pull request
[`34068`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/34068) added extraction,
resolution, and forwarding of those images. Its merge commit is
[`9c86a9fd23469e7c10b80be3ed6503ee9cd8da0e`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9c86a9fd23469e7c10b80be3ed6503ee9cd8da0e),
with parent `36e2e04a32c2a94eafc83fd7e1e82a89045e2e9f`.

| File | Revision | Git blob | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai_http_parent.ts` | `36e2e04a32c2a94eafc83fd7e1e82a89045e2e9f` | `10e8d713feed548faba7ef3d0c40a1e70eaab050` | `23eabe7181281edcc518372f6fd068273f6b3ab6354bcd623a2ddf8c911d5a15` |
| `openai_http_fix.ts` | `9c86a9fd23469e7c10b80be3ed6503ee9cd8da0e` | `1f37dfb1fae6afc1c3235238daa97c5ff165d162` | `d79b2846dd2f05b9d0d19c37bb53992bc360f35e23cacb3e8992fd4939662c10` |
| `openai_http_parent.test.ts` | parent | `c9d429521a46dc165416dc5e72b8f63722d0b0c0` | `a01f70ae9848c47e7336d55bc2bcb83091afb827c3382e3f6a21332601df763a` |
| `openai_http_fix.test.ts` | fix | `f3ab97093ba51618af0cf109c57f297af6647e07` | `bac6ac56f54cb5b7c9b5c81dfd3bed2d35f7c9fe18052da2b2f8ecfc1dd85358` |

`native_regression_test.patch` is the exact test-file diff between the parent
and fix commits. Applying only that patch to the parent makes the upstream
four-test file fail because `agentCommand.images` is `undefined`. The same file
passes at the fix commit. The native run starts the upstream loopback gateway
with its mocked agent command and makes no provider or model call.

Normal artifact verification checks source identity and executes the exact
upstream TypeScript extraction and command-input functions on local PNG and
JPEG fixtures. A thin released adapter presents the captured command input to
the already frozen predicate. This is one deliberately selected external
holdout, not a random incident sample or a full deployment-frequency study.

The files remain under the upstream MIT license reproduced in `LICENSE`.
